Job description

Please ensure you meet all criteria by reading the profile thoroughly before applying. Candidates who are the strongest match will be contacted for the next step.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a creative and proactive iOS Developer to join our team of talented engineers in designing and building the next generation of our mobile applications. This is a primary role within the Software Engineering function of our flagship product development team, TagMatiks. You will be responsible for developing high-performance, patented software that serves as the bridge between enterprise users and complex RFID/IoT hardware. If you are a self-motivated developer with a passion for Object-Oriented Design and the latest mobile technologies, you will thrive in this fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

End-to-End Development: Design, build, and maintain advanced applications for the iOS platform using Swift and Objective-C.
Collaborative Engineering: Work closely with product owners, solution architects, and project managers throughout the SDLC to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Hardware Integration: Utilize CocoaPods and specialized frameworks to integrate mobile software with 3rd-party SDKs and RFID hardware.
Data Architecture: Implement robust offline storage solutions using SQLite and CoreData, ensuring efficient database design and data integrity.
Performance Optimization: Maximize application responsiveness through expert use of GCD, Multi-threading, and proactive memory management.
Iterative Delivery: Participate in Agile development cycles, performing code reviews and contributing to continuous improvement of the mobile ecosystem.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Experience: 0-2 years of progressive experience in iOS software engineering and product development.
Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Swift, Objective-C, Cocoa Touch, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
Architectural Knowledge: A solid understanding of common design patterns, specifically MVVM and MVC.
Storage & Concurrency: Proven skills in SQLite database design and an "Above Average" understanding of Concurrent programming (GCD & Threading).
Tools: Hands-on experience with version control (Git), CocoaPods, and dependency management.
Education: Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical discipline.

YOU WILL THRIVE HERE IF YOU

Have a deep appreciation for iOS UX guidelines and building intuitive, user-centric interfaces.
Are a "self-starter" who excels in a fast-paced environment and can handle complex, patented product development.
Possess a strong understanding of common programming tools and paradigms, including version control and framework management.
Are interested in IoT, RFID technology, or how AI/Machine Learning can be leveraged within mobile platforms.
Knowing Swift and SwiftUI, would be an added advantage.

WHATS IN IT FOR YOU

Mentorship & Innovation: Work on the patented TagMatiks platform alongside industry experts in the globally recognized RFID and IoT space.
Fortune 500 Impact: Directly influence the business intelligence solutions used by the world’s largest companies in Healthcare, Logistics, and Manufacturing.
Professional Growth: A clear path within an ISO-certified global company that has led the industry for over 25 years.

PopVax is an Indian full-stack biotech building first-in-class and best-in-class vaccines and cancer immunotherapies using machine learning-driven protein design and relentless empiricism. We design, develop, and manufacture our own RNA medicines end-to-end because we believe great pharmaceutical science can only flourish in tight feedback loops that iterate rapidly. PopVax s experimental work and clinical dose production is based at the RNA Foundry , our integrated R&D and GMP-capable clinical dose production facility in Hyderabad.
PopVaxs north star is our goal of developing novel vaccines and therapeutics over the next decade with the cumulative ability to save 1 million lives each year the Million Lives Mission. To that end, we are developing first-in-class vaccines against Hepatitis C, Strep A, and adult pulmonary TB; broadly-protective best-in-class vaccines against COVID-19, influenza, malaria, and HPV; and precision immunotherapies against hard-to-treat solid tumours such as liver cancer and pancreatic cancer. Beyond existing diseases, we are leveraging our high-speed platform to build rapid-response biosecurity capabilities against engineered
de novo
pathogens.
Our mission is funded by Vitalik Buterin s Balvi Fund, the Gates Foundation, the US Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA), Renaissance Philanthropy, and Good Ventures, with individual investments from Enveda founder Viswa Colluru and Tesla self-driving AI pioneer Dhaval Shroff. Our first program, an open-source broadly-protective COVID-19 vaccine, will begin a Phase I clinical trial in Australia in mid-2026. This is just the start we intend to advance 6+ novel vaccine and immunotherapy programs into human clinical trials over the next three years, decisively demonstrating that world-class biotech R&D is possible in India.
No matter the job title, each person s role at PopVax is ultimately about helping bring safe, effective new medicines that represent a step-change over the current standard-of-care to the people who need them, as quickly as possible. If you are looking for a place where the ambition is high, the learning curve is steep, and the work matters to billions, you ll feel at home here.
If you re excited by the idea of advancing scientific, clinical, and regulatory frontiers of vaccines and immunotherapies, spending each day developing medicines with the potential to save millions of lives, and building a generational global pharmaceutical company in India along the way join us!
Role Overview
Most software engineers build products for users theyve never met. You wont have that problem. Your users will be ten feet away from you, pipetting something into a 96-well plate.
PopVax is a full-stack mRNA biotech company we design, develop, and manufacture vaccines and immunotherapies, and we take them to clinic at a pace that makes most pharma companies nervous. Our labs are where the core work happens: experiments are designed, samples are processed, assays are run, data is generated, and decisions are made that determine whether a vaccine candidate moves forward or doesnt.
Heres the thing about labs, though even very good ones. The science is cutting-edge, but the software that supports it often isnt. A scientist finishes a run on an instrument and spends the next three hours copy-pasting outputs into a spreadsheet to make a graph. An experiments results live in one persons notebook and another persons email and a third persons USB drive. A project manager asks "where are we on this program" and the answer requires assembling information from six different places, none of which talk to each other.
These arent science problems. Theyre software problems. And they slow down the science.
We need someone who will sit inside the lab, understand the science well enough to ask the right questions, and build the software that makes the whole operation faster, smarter, and less dependent on manual drudgery.
That someone is our Benchside Software Engineer.
What Youll Actually Do
Youll be embedded physically in the lab. Not supporting it from a desk three floors away, not building tools based on a requirements doc someone emailed you. Youll attend team meetings, watch how experiments are run, see where data gets stuck, notice where a scientist is doing something by hand that a script could do in seconds, and then go build the thing that fixes it.
The "product" in this role is whatever makes the scientists faster and smarter. Some weeks thatll be a data pipeline. Other weeks itll be a dashboard. Other weeks itll be a small internal tool that automates something nobody even realized could be automated until you pointed it out.
Specifically, you will:
Build workflow software. Design and build internal tools and lightweight applications that digitise, track, and accelerate experimental workflows from experiment design through data capture to results. Right now, some of these workflows involve whiteboards, spreadsheets, and verbal handoffs. Youll turn them into something that actually scales.
Create data pipelines that work. Experiments and instruments generate raw data. That data needs to become clean, structured, and usable by scientists who want to interpret results, by leadership who want to track program progress, and by teams who need to make decisions quickly. Youll build the pipelines that make raw outputs into something people can actually act on.
Build dashboards that tell the truth. R&D teams and leadership need real-time visibility into experimental progress, assay results, and program status. Youll build internal dashboards that surface this information clearly not vanity metrics, but the views that help people understand where things stand and what needs attention.
Replace manual coordination with software. Lab operations involve a surprising amount of repetitive coordination work tracking samples, scheduling instrument time, managing inventory, communicating status across teams. Youll identify the places where people are doing this by hand and build software that just handles it.
Understand before you build. This is perhaps the most important part. Youll spend real time with scientists. Youll learn what experiments theyre running, how data flows from bench to decision, and where things break down. Youll ask questions lots of them and build tools that fit how people actually work, not how you imagine they work from the other side of a Jira ticket.

Youre a software engineer who is genuinely curious about science. You dont need a biology degree well teach you the biology. The curiosity matters because you cant build good tools for a domain you dont care about understanding.
Youre a strong generalist. Python is probably your primary tool, but you pick up whatevers needed a new framework, a dashboarding library, a database you havent used before. Youve built things end-to-end: a data pipeline, an internal tool, an analysis dashboard, a script that saved someone hours of tedious work. It doesnt have to be fancy. It has to be real, and you have to be able to show us.
You ask good questions. You spend time understanding the problem before jumping to the solution. Youve probably been the person in a group project who said "wait, what are we actually trying to do here" and saved everyone a week of wasted work.

This includes customer deployments, upgrades, and incident response. You will be expected to go on-site for our airgapped customers, occasionally, to assist on-prem deployments. WHAT MAKES US, US

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

In SimCorp, we help some of the biggest financial institutions in the world be successful by simplifying their accounting, operations, and investments. We do this through IT systems, processes, and financial knowledge. High quality, performing, secure, and cost-effective software is at the core of what we do. To build, maintain and operate this software, engineers are essential to us.

You will be working with a team of about 12 people located in Noida/Hyderabad in India and Copenhagen, Denmark. The Product Development team functions as a center of enablement for artificial intelligence (AI), providing knowledge and guidelines to other teams, as well as working hands on implementing and operating solutions with AI.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

The Lead Software Engineer at SimCorp, at the IC5 grade, is responsible for leading and driving the design, development, and implementation of complex software solutions. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop high-quality software that meets business requirements and technical specifications. The Lead Software Engineer takes ownership of key engineering projects, provides technical guidance to junior engineers, and ensures that software is delivered on time and within scope. This position requires advanced problem-solving skills, expertise in software engineering practices, and the ability to work in a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

We work team-based, so your primary responsibility is as a team member. You need to make sure the team delivers on its commitments, that it s a good place to work for you and your teammates, and that it continuously improves.

Daily tasks are for example:

Developing plugins and tools for generative AI models, Agentic AI solutions.

Going from proof-of-concepts to high quality, production ready solutions.

Integrating AI functionality with modules and Agents developed by other teams

Lead the design and development of software solutions, ensuring they meet business needs and technical requirements

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams, cultivating a collaborative and high-performance environment

Collaborate with product management, design, and quality assurance teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery of software solutions

Identify and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring high-quality solutions that are scalable, reliable, and performant

Ensure adherence to software development best practices, including coding standards, testing, and documentation

Take ownership of key features and components, driving their design and implementation from concept to delivery

Continuously assess and improve engineering processes, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality

Participate in code reviews, ensuring that the team follows best practices and maintains high standards for software quality

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.

7+ years of direct experience with .NET technologies (C#, Microsoft .NET).

Experience in building AI solutions (preferably 2+ years), with a keen interest in Agentic AI and associated projects will be an added advantage.

Experience with generative AI tools like OpenAI for Azure, protocols like A2A/MCP plugins & function calls for example through SemanticKernel.

Comprehensive understanding and practical experience with application architecture, covering both frontend and backend systems

Proficiency in working with Azure and Azure DevOps.

Experience with Agile development methodologies, as well as DevOps and CI/CD practices

Demonstrating responsibility. Comfortable taking the lead on tasks.

Earn trust, think big, and take calculated risks.

You collaborate with team members to work towards common goals.

Solid problem-solving skills and comfortable questioning assumptions and as-is.

Exhibits a consistent approach and a creative mindset.

Thrives in a collaborative environment and values teamwork

Like to have fun at work and positivity comes easily to you

Proficient English verbal and communication skills

BENEFITS

Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.

Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.

Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.

Inclusive and diverse company culture

Work-life balance We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace

Empowerment We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

Mednevo is an early-stage AI healthcare startup revolutionizing *primary healthcare* in India. We combine *cutting-edge AI technology* with a genuine patient-first approach to deliver accessible, personalized, and high-quality care.
Our platform integrates *on-demand virtual consultations, in-home doctor visits, proactive wellness monitoring, and AI-powered tools for interactive consultations, patient education, and personalized health insights. We are particularly focused on making quality care — including pediatric care — more efficient, affordable, and scalable across urban and semi-urban India.
As a small, high-impact team (2-10 people), we move fast and solve real problems: reducing wait times, supporting clinical decisions with AI, improving outcomes for families and children, and building the future of intelligent healthcare delivery.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a passionate Medical Doctor to join as a Co-Founder. This is not a traditional clinical job — it is a founding leadership role where you will shape the clinical vision, build the product alongside AI engineers, and help scale a mission-driven healthcare ecosystem.
You will bring real-world medical expertise (especially in pediatrics) to ensure our AI tools are clinically accurate, safe, empathetic, and truly useful for Indian families and doctors.
Key Responsibilities
• Clinical Leadership & Product Vision: Co-define the medical strategy and clinical pathways, with special focus on pediatric care, primary health, preventive wellness, and common childhood conditions.
• AI + Medicine Integration: Work closely with AI engineers to train, validate, and refine AI models for symptom assessment, triage, personalized advice, and decision support. Provide clinical oversight to ensure safety and accuracy.
• Patient Care Excellence: Lead or supervise virtual consultations and in-home visits (initially hands-on, later more strategic). Help design workflows that blend human empathy with AI efficiency.
• Product Development: Collaborate on building user-friendly tools for doctors, patients, and parents — including pediatric growth tracking, vaccination reminders, developmental screening, and family health management.
• Regulatory & Quality: Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, data privacy (HIPAA-like standards), and medical ethics in India.
• Growth & Ecosystem Building: Support fundraising, partnerships with hospitals/clinics, go-to-market strategy, and expansion of our AI-hospital ecosystem. Represent Mednevo at medical conferences and among the doctor community.
• Team & Culture: Help build a high-trust, innovative team culture that attracts top medical and tech talent.
What We’re Looking For
• Medical Qualification: MBBS from a recognized institution (mandatory). MD/DNB Pediatrics (pursuing or completed) is a strong advantage.
• Experience: 0-2 years post-MBBS (including internships or residency). Fresh graduates or final-year MD candidates with strong academic records and genuine interest in technology are encouraged to apply.
• Passion for AI & Innovation: Curiosity or experience in digital health, telemedicine, or AI applications in medicine. No prior tech experience required — we value clinical insight and willingness to learn.
• Pediatric Interest: Strong preference for candidates with exposure to or deep interest in pediatrics — child health, neonatology, developmental pediatrics, or family medicine.
• Founder Mindset: Entrepreneurial spirit, ownership attitude, resilience, and excitement about building something from the ground up. Ability to wear multiple hats in a fast-paced startup.
• Skills: Excellent communication (especially with patients/parents), empathy, basic tech-savviness, and comfort working in a remote/hybrid setup.
• Location: Open to candidates in Tamil Nadu, Kerala, or willing to relocate/base in Chennai/Thiruvananthapuram.
What We Offer

Position Overview:

The Dashboard Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining interactive dashboards and data visualization solutions that transform complex data into actionable insights. This role serves as a critical bridge between raw data and strategic decision-making, enabling stakeholders across the organization to understand performance metrics, trends, and opportunities through intuitive visual interfaces.

Core Responsibilities:

Dashboard Design and Development The Dashboard Developer creates compelling, user-centered dashboards that present key performance indicators, metrics, and analytics in clear, accessible formats. This involves understanding business requirements, translating them into visual specifications, and building solutions using industry-standard business intelligence and visualization tools. The developer ensures dashboards are intuitive, responsive, and aligned with user workflows and decision-making processes.

Data Integration and Management Working closely with data engineering and IT teams, the Dashboard Developer connects multiple data sources including databases, APIs, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems to create unified views of organizational data. They ensure data accuracy, implement appropriate data refresh schedules, and optimize queries for performance. This includes understanding data structures, establishing proper data pipelines, and maintaining data integrity throughout the visualization process.

Stakeholder Collaboration and Requirements Gathering The role requires continuous engagement with business stakeholders, executives, and end users to understand their analytical needs and decision-making contexts. The Dashboard Developer conducts requirements sessions, presents prototypes, gathers feedback, and iteratively refines solutions to ensure they deliver meaningful value. Strong communication skills enable the developer to translate technical capabilities into business benefits and vice versa.

Maintenance, Optimization, and Enhancement Ongoing stewardship of existing dashboards is essential. The Dashboard Developer monitors dashboard performance, troubleshoots issues, implements updates based on changing business needs, and continuously optimizes for speed and usability. They proactively identify opportunities to enhance existing solutions and retire outdated or underutilized dashboards.

Governance, Documentation, and Best Practices The developer establishes and maintains documentation for all dashboard solutions, including data dictionaries, user guides, and technical specifications. They implement governance standards around naming conventions, color schemes, branding guidelines, and accessibility requirements. The role also involves promoting data literacy and best practices for visualization design across the organization.

Key Technical Competencies:

Strong proficiency in business intelligence platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, or Looker is essential. The candidate should demonstrate expertise in SQL for data extraction and manipulation, understanding of data warehousing concepts, and familiarity with ETL processes. Knowledge of scripting languages like Python or R for advanced analytics, experience with cloud data platforms, and understanding of API integration enhance the candidates capability to deliver sophisticated solutions.

Critical Success Factors:

Success in this role is measured by the adoption and impact of dashboard solutions on organizational decision-making. The Dashboard Developer must balance technical excellence with business acumen, aesthetic design with functional utility, and innovation with reliability. The ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to evolving requirements, and deliver solutions that genuinely empower users distinguishes exceptional performers in this role.

This position is fundamental to enabling data-driven culture and supporting strategic initiatives across Vendor Management and IT Asset Management functions, where visibility into vendor performance, asset utilization, costs, and compliance metrics directly influences operational effectiveness and risk management
